name: vugola
description: Turn long videos into captioned short clips, schedule social posts, and manage channel automations from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Clip, caption, schedule, and automate video content
interface.longDescription: Use your Vugola workspace from ChatGPT and Codex to turn public video links into captioned short clips, check rendering progress, retrieve downloads, schedule social posts, and manage hands-free YouTube channel automations.
defaultPrompt: Turn this interview into five vertical clips with captions: <video URL>
Add highlighted captions to this video: <video URL>
Show my Vugola credits and recent clipping job status
Set up an automation for this YouTube channel after confirming the destinations and schedule
